mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.name AS scenic_spot_name, u.real_name AS operator_name, oi.id AS item_id, oi.order_id AS item_order_id, oi.ticket_type_id AS item_ticket_type_id, oi.ticket_name AS item_ticket_name, oi.price AS item_price, oi.quantity AS item_quantity, oi.subtotal AS item_subtotal FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN scenic_spot s ON o.scenic_spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ticket_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT o.*, s.name AS scenic_spot_name, u.real_name AS operator_name, oi.id AS item_id, oi.order_id AS item_order_id, oi.ticket_type_id AS item_ticket_type_id, oi.ticket_name AS item_ticket_name, oi.price AS item_price, oi.quantity AS item_quantity, oi.subtotal AS item_subtotal FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN scenic_spot s ON o.scenic_spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ticket_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.deleted = 0
